messages.subject: ez version 4.2-0 released
parts:
Hi folks,

Just a heads up that version 4.2-0 of ez has now been released. This version fixes a bug in ezANOVA whereby a type=3 mixed anova with unequal groups would yield the "wrong" results. The word "wrong" is in quotes because the returned results in that case were pretty similar to those obtained from the arguably more appropriate type=2 analysis. Nonetheless, those wishing for true type=3 results should update and re-run your analyses.

Cheers,

Mike

--
Mike Lawrence
Graduate Student
